entities.name: Concrete Parapet Wall
entities.why: This specific structure failed, acting as the physical representation of all the design and maintenance flaws.

entities.name: Taum Sauk Upper Reservoir
entities.why: This man-made lake is the source of the flood and the central point of failure.

entities.name: Proffit Mountain
entities.why: It is the primary geographic setting for the entire disaster and its consequences.

entities.name: Control Computer
entities.why: It is the automated system that made flawed decisions based on faulty inputs, central to the story's theme.

entities.name: Taum Sauk Pumped-Storage Plant
entities.why: It is the core engineered system that failed, causing the disaster.

entities.name: Toops House
entities.why: It is the direct target of the flood, representing the immediate human impact of the disaster.

entities.name: Software Offset
entities.why: This action represents a deliberate decision to cover up a physical problem with a software fix, directly contributing to the disaster.

entities.name: Pressure Sensors
entities.why: Their incorrect readings, due to unanchored pipes, were the initial flaw in the system.

entities.name: Jerry Toops
entities.why: He is a central victim and his family's survival is key to the story's outcome.

entities.name: Emergency Probes
entities.why: These safety devices were misconfigured or placed incorrectly, rendering them useless as a fail-safe.

entities.name: Lisa Toops
entities.why: She is a central victim and her family's survival is key to the story's outcome.

entities.name: Emails
entities.why: These documents provide irrefutable evidence that key personnel were aware of the risks before the failure.

entities.name: Ameren
entities.why: It is the company legally and financially responsible for the disaster and its aftermath.

entities.name: Pumps
entities.why: These components are central to the plant's operation and their continued function, despite warnings, led to the overflow.

entities.name: Toops baby (seven-month-old)
entities.why: The baby's survival through extreme conditions emphasizes the miraculous nature of the family's escape.

entities.name: Plastic Sensor Pipes
entities.why: Their unanchored state caused the pressure sensors to report incorrect water levels.

entities.name: Tanner Toops (five-year-old)
entities.why: His specific injuries and survival are highlighted in the story's aftermath.

entities.name: Saint Louis
entities.why: It represents the remote control center, emphasizing the distance and disconnect from the physical plant.

entities.name: Depth Gauge
entities.why: Its sinking with the wall disguised the true water level, representing a systemic oversight.

entities.name: State of Missouri
entities.why: It is the governmental entity affected by and involved in the aftermath of the disaster.

entities.name: Shut-ins
entities.why: It is a natural feature downstream, affected by the flood and later restored, showing the environmental impact and recovery.

entities.name: Ozark Mountains
entities.why: It provides the broader geographical context for the story's setting.
